description: Crossing Inventory Data (Form 71) - Current is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Railroads", published or maintained by FRA Safe Team. A highway-rail crossing is a location where a public highway, road, street, or private roadway, including associated sidewalks and pathways, crosses one or more railroad tracks. All such crossings are reported by railroads and state Department of Transportations to the FRA on Form FRA F 6180.71 U.S. DOT Crossing Inventory Form. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Railroads". It has 265 columns, among them Mast Mounted Flashing Light Type, Separate Track Railroad 2 , Separate Track Railroad 1 , Separate Track , Highway Name , Block Number . The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last data update. Attribution given: FRA Safe Team. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
